```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

path <- "/Users/maiko/Desktop/EDLD652_Diss/Data"

dismissed_l <- read_csv(file.path(path,"summary_dismissed_by_language.csv"),    show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(Category="Dismissed")
movedout_l  <- read_csv(file.path(path,"summary_movedout_by_language.csv"),     show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(Category="Moved Out")
notelig_l   <- read_csv(file.path(path,"summary_noteligible_by_language.csv"),  show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(Category="Not Eligible")
partb_l     <- read_csv(file.path(path,"summary_partb_eligible_by_language.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(Category="Part B Eligible")
withd_l     <- read_csv(file.path(path,"summary_withdrawn_by_language.csv"),    show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(Category="Withdrawn")

all_lang <- bind_rows(dismissed_l, movedout_l, notelig_l, partb_l, withd_l) %>%
  mutate(
    Primary.Language = factor(Primary.Language, levels = c("English","Spanish","Other Languages")),
    Category         = factor(Category, levels = c("Dismissed","Moved Out","Not Eligible","Part B Eligible","Withdrawn")),
    P_Value          = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(P_Value)),
    ns               = is.na(P_Value) | P_Value >= 0.05,  # TRUE = non-significant
    label            = sprintf("%.2f", Odds_Ratio)
  )

# sanity check
names(all_lang)
table("ns" = "ns" %in% names(all_lang))

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# optional: order languages A→Z from top
all_lang$Primary.Language <- factor(all_lang$Primary.Language,
                                    levels = rev(sort(levels(all_lang$Primary.Language))))

ggplot(all_lang, aes(Category, Primary.Language)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = Odds_Ratio), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#a50026", mid = "white", high = "#081d58",
                       midpoint = 1, name = "Odds Ratio") +
  geom_tile(data = dplyr::filter(all_lang, ns), fill = "grey60", color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label, color = ns), size = 3.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE`="white", `FALSE`="black"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Exit Category", y = "Primary Language")

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# (optional) order languages A→Z from top
all_lang <- all_lang %>%
  mutate(Primary.Language = factor(Primary.Language,
                                   levels = rev(sort(levels(Primary.Language)))))

ggplot(all_lang, aes(Category, Primary.Language)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = Odds_Ratio), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#a50026", mid = "white", high = "#081d58",
                       midpoint = 1, name = "Odds Ratio") +
  # gray overlay for non-significant cells
  geom_tile(data = dplyr::filter(all_lang, ns), fill = "grey60", color = "white") +
  # numbers on tiles (white on gray, black otherwise)
  geom_text(aes(label = label, color = ns), size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "black"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Exit Category", y = "Primary Language") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 13, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12)
  )

```

```{r}
# thresholds for when tile is "dark" enough to need white text
low_red   <- 0.75   # OR below this → white text
high_blue <- 1.25   # OR above this → white text

# (optional) order languages A→Z from top + compute text color
all_lang <- all_lang %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Primary.Language = factor(Primary.Language,
                              levels = rev(sort(levels(Primary.Language)))),
    txt_col = ifelse(ns | Odds_Ratio < low_red | Odds_Ratio > high_blue, "white", "black")
  )

ggplot(all_lang, aes(Category, Primary.Language)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = Odds_Ratio), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#a50026", mid = "white", high = "#081d58",
                       midpoint = 1, name = "Odds Ratio") +
  # gray overlay for non-significant cells
  geom_tile(data = dplyr::filter(all_lang, ns), fill = "grey60", color = "white") +
  # numbers on tiles: white on gray OR extreme colors, black otherwise
  geom_text(aes(label = label, color = txt_col), size = 4) +
  scale_color_identity(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Exit Category", y = "Primary Language") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 13, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```

```{r}
forest_df <- all_lang %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lo = Lower_CI,
    hi = Upper_CI,
    Primary.Language = factor(Primary.Language,
                              levels = c("English", "Spanish", "Other Languages")),
    Category = forcats::fct_recode(Category,
                                   "Dismissed for Lost Contact" = "Dismissed"),
    Category = forcats::fct_rev(Category),
    fill_col = ifelse(ns, "ns", as.character(Primary.Language))
  )

group_cols   <- c("English" = "#2a78d6",
                  "Spanish" = "#eb6834",
                  "Other Languages" = "#1baf7a")
group_labels <- c("English" = "English-only",
                  "Spanish" = "Spanish-only",
                  "Other Languages" = "Other Single and Multiple Languages")
group_shapes <- c("English" = 21, "Spanish" = 22, "Other Languages" = 24)

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)

forest <- ggplot(forest_df,
                 aes(x = Category, y = Odds_Ratio, ymin = lo, ymax = hi,
                     color = Primary.Language, shape = Primary.Language,
                     group = forcats::fct_rev(Primary.Language))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_linerange(position = dodge, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = fill_col), position = dodge, size = 2.8, stroke = 1) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2),
                limits = c(0.38, 2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols, labels = group_labels) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = group_shapes, labels = group_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(group_cols, ns = "white"), guide = "none") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Odds ratio (95% CI, log scale)",
       color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(fill = unname(group_cols))),
         shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(fill = unname(group_cols)))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position    = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

forest
```

```{r}
forest_df <- all_lang %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lo = Lower_CI,
    hi = Upper_CI,
    Primary.Language = factor(Primary.Language,
                              levels = c("English", "Spanish", "Other Languages")),
    Category = forcats::fct_recode(Category,
                                   "Dismissed for Lost Contact" = "Dismissed"),
    Category = forcats::fct_rev(Category),
    fill_col = ifelse(ns, "ns", as.character(Primary.Language)),
    lang     = as.character(Primary.Language),
    xpos     = as.numeric(Category) +
      c("English" = 0.22, "Spanish" = 0, "Other Languages" = -0.22)[lang],
    letter   = c("English" = "E", "Spanish" = "S", "Other Languages" = "O")[lang]
  )

group_cols   <- c("English" = "#2a78d6",
                  "Spanish" = "#eb6834",
                  "Other Languages" = "#1baf7a")
group_labels <- c("English" = "E = English-only",
                  "Spanish" = "S = Spanish-only",
                  "Other Languages" = "O = Other Single and Multiple Languages")

forest <- ggplot(forest_df, aes(x = xpos, y = Odds_Ratio, color = Primary.Language)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = fill_col), shape = 21, size = 5, stroke = 1) +
  # white letters on filled (significant) circles
  geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(forest_df, !ns), aes(label = letter),
            color = "white", size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  # colored letters on hollow (not significant) circles
  geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(forest_df, ns), aes(label = letter),
            size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(forest_df$Category)),
                     labels = levels(forest_df$Category)) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2),
                limits = c(0.38, 2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols, labels = group_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(group_cols, ns = "white"), guide = "none") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Odds ratio (95% CI, log scale)", color = NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2,
                              override.aes = list(fill = unname(group_cols),
                                                  shape = 21, size = 4))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position    = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

forest
```

```{r}
forest_df <- all_lang %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lo = Lower_CI,
    hi = Upper_CI,
    Primary.Language = factor(Primary.Language,
                              levels = c("English", "Spanish", "Other Languages")),
    Category = forcats::fct_recode(Category,
                                   "Dismissed for Lost Contact" = "Dismissed"),
    Category = factor(Category, levels = rev(c("Not Eligible",
                                               "Part B Eligible",
                                               "Dismissed for Lost Contact",
                                               "Moved Out",
                                               "Withdrawn", 
                                               "Not Determined"))),
    fill_col = ifelse(ns, "ns", as.character(Primary.Language)),
    lang     = as.character(Primary.Language),
    xpos     = as.numeric(Category) +
      c("English" = 0.22, "Spanish" = 0, "Other Languages" = -0.22)[lang],
    letter   = c("English" = "E", "Spanish" = "S", "Other Languages" = "O")[lang]
  )

group_cols <- c("English"         = "#0072B2",   # blue
                "Spanish"         = "#D55E00",   # vermillion
                "Other Languages" = "#009E73")   # bluish green
group_labels <- c("English" = "E = English-only",
                  "Spanish" = "S = Spanish-only",
                  "Other Languages" = "O = Other Single and Multiple Languages")

forest <- ggplot(forest_df, aes(x = xpos, y = Odds_Ratio, color = Primary.Language)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = fill_col), shape = 21, size = 5, stroke = 1) +
  # white letters on filled (significant) circles
  geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(forest_df, !ns), aes(label = letter),
            color = "white", size = 2.8, fontface = "bold",
            family = "Times New Roman", show.legend = FALSE) +
  # colored letters on hollow (not significant) circles
  geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(forest_df, ns), aes(label = letter),
            size = 2.8, fontface = "bold",
            family = "Times New Roman", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(forest_df$Category)),   # <- restored line
                     labels = levels(forest_df$Category)) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2),
                limits = c(0.38, 2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols, labels = group_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(group_cols, ns = "white"), guide = "none") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Odds ratio (95% CI, log scale)", color = NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2,
                              override.aes = list(fill = unname(group_cols),
                                                  shape = 21, size = 4))) +
  theme_light(base_size = 10, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  theme(legend.position    = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text          = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title         = element_text(color = "black"))

forest
```

```{r}
# Playing with corrplot type chart 1
bubble_df <- forest_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Category         = forcats::fct_rev(Category),          # Not Eligible on the left
    Primary.Language = forcats::fct_rev(Primary.Language),  # English on top
    log_or = log(Odds_Ratio),
    label  = sprintf("%.2f\n[%.2f, %.2f]", Odds_Ratio, lo, hi)
  )

bubble_df %>% dplyr::select(Primary.Language, Category, Odds_Ratio, label, ns)
```

```{r}
# Playing with corrplot type chart 2
lang_labels <- c("English"         = "English-only",
                 "Spanish"         = "Spanish-only",
                 "Other Languages" = "Other Single and\nMultiple Languages")

bubble <- ggplot(bubble_df, aes(x = Category, y = Primary.Language)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = abs(log_or), fill = ifelse(ns, NA, log_or)),
             shape = 21, color = "gray50", stroke = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label, color = ns),
            nudge_y = -0.42, size = 3.2, lineheight = 0.9,
            family = "Times New Roman") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#08306b", mid = "white", high = "#a50026",
                       midpoint = 0,
                       limits = log(c(0.67, 1.5)),
                       breaks = log(c(0.67, 0.8, 1, 1.25, 1.5)),
                       labels = c("0.67", "0.8", "1", "1.25", "1.5"),
                       oob = scales::squish,
                       na.value = "white", name = "Odds ratio") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(7, 22), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "gray10", "TRUE" = "gray55"),
                     guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top",
                   labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, 12)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = lang_labels,
                   expand = expansion(add = c(0.8, 0.5))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.key.height = unit(1.2, "cm"))

bubble
```
